english.title: Not being a bona fide airline passenger fail to wear pass in restricted area at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being a bona fide airline passenger, while in a restricted area at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport, failed to wear a pass issued to you by or on behalf of the Airport Company so that it was reasonably visible at all times
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(17) and 2(1) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
not being a bona fide airline passenger
while in a restricted area at Southampton Airport
failed to wear a pass issued to you
by / on behalf of the Airport Company
so that it was reasonably visible at all times

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, not being a bona fide airline passenger, while in a restricted area at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport, failed to wear a pass issued to the defendant by or on behalf of the Airport Company so that it was reasonably visible at all times.
